headline: How long before I know I'm not destined to be alone?
note: Wired 2026-08-25 from fb-tarot/docs/drafts/shadow/REVIEW-money-alone-commit-2026-08-25.md — approved copy, transferred verbatim. Reuses the existing LONELINESS_TAROT_HOOKS frame; no new guard.

a: You turned the Magician. You couldn't see the cards, yet your hand found the one with every possibility still on the table.
The cup, coin, blade and wand all remain in front of him.
You asked how long before you know you are not destined to be alone. The complete table catches me.
You are still alone, and you are waiting for time to disprove the fear.
I keep coming back to something between the open possibility and connection. I don't think it began with you.
Let me look closer at what's doing this…
b: You turned the Hanged Man. The backs hid him, but you reached for the one held by a single thing.
One rope holds one ankle. The rest of him hangs loose.
You asked for a length that would settle the destiny question. This card makes me look at the single rope.
Still, the pause has left the destiny question hanging.
Something has hold of the question and keeps it from resolving cleanly. I don't think this began with you.
Let me see what's holding the question…
c: You turned the Fool. Nothing gave the picture away, but your hand went to the open beginning.
The small bundle on his stick is all he has packed.
You asked when you can stop believing solitude is destined. The beginning on this card holds my attention.
But the road has no one else on it, and you are asking time to settle what that means.
Something appears just where a new answer would begin. I don't think it started with you.
Now let's look at what's behind this…
